few_shot_example.description: Find three numbers that sum to zero
few_shot_example.solution:
def three_sum(nums: list[int]) -> list[list[int]]:
    nums.sort()
    result = []
    for i in range(len(nums)-2):
        if i > 0 and nums[i] == nums[i-1]: continue
        lo, hi = i+1, len(nums)-1
        while lo < hi:
            s = nums[i]+nums[lo]+nums[hi]
            if s == 0: result.append([nums[i],nums[lo],nums[hi]]); lo+=1; hi-=1
            elif s < 0: lo+=1
            else: hi-=1
    return result

description: Write a function that checks if a number is a power of two.

few_shot_example.description: Find the next power of two
few_shot_example.solution:
def next_power_of_two(n: int) -> int:
    if n <= 0: return 1
    n -= 1
    n |= n >> 1; n |= n >> 2; n |= n >> 4; n |= n >> 8; n |= n >> 16
    return n + 1
